{"metadata":{"description":"DSH adapter for OpenCode Zen free models (maintained fork with gateway-compat fixes)","id":"gh:1374274469","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-plugin-adapter","slug":"1624318455/dsh-plugin-adapter","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH adapter for OpenCode Zen free models (maintained fork with gateway-compat fixes)"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-plugin-adapter"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"No API key. No registration. No extra process."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"dsh-plugin-adapter registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from
OpenCode Zen's **a"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"nonymous free lane** — the same
models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DS"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"H model
picker as a regular provider called `zen-free` (`opencode2dsh` stays
registered as a legacy "},{"id":"p6s4","text":"alias so old sessions keep working)."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode
CLI (same user agent, sam"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"e correlation headers), and the model catalog stays
fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" is nothing to log into and
nothing to host."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Highlights"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat
- **Nati"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ve adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy G"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"o sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`)
- **CLI-identical disguise** — reques"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ts carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per convers"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"ation
- **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DS"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"H's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"High otherwise); Off sends `reasoning_effort: "none"` upstream to actually stop thinking, and no sel"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"ection keeps the provider default
- **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ fr"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"ee verdict (models.dev price 0, or a `-free` id the lane itself serves free), falling back to offlin"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"e cache and a verified static list
- **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and "},{"id":"p9s11","text":"a written health snapshot for diagnostics
- **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limi"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"t, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by D"},{"id":"p9s13","text":" auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**From the plugin market** (recommended, once listed):
in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, sea"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"rch `dsh-plugin-adapter`,
one-click install."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**From GitHub**:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"**From npm**:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"**From source** (build the tarball yourself):"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"**Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from
the **zen-free** group."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) with a web profile; Node.js ≥ 20 (already
present if DSH runs); outb"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"> **Upgrading from ≤ 0.3.x**: the plugin id changed from `opencode2dsh` to
> `dsh-plugin-adapter` in"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" 0.4.0. DSH attaches the config block to the plugin
> by that id, so rename the `- id:` line in your"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" live `cordis.patch.yml` in
> the same step — otherwise the config (e.g. a pinned `gatewaySession`) "},{"id":"p23s4","text":"is
> silently dropped. The data directory moved with it (`~/.opencode2dsh` →
> `~/.dsh-plugin-adapte"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"r`): the plugin copies the old one over on first
> start and parks it as `~/.opencode2dsh.bak-<date>"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"`, which you can delete
> once the new setup works."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Option | Default | Description |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy l"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ocal-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. |
| `provid"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"erId` | `zen-free` | Provider name shown in DSH (`opencode2dsh` stays registered as a legacy alias)."},{"id":"p25s4","text":" |
| `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h"},{"id":"p25s5","text":". |
| `gatewaySession` | — | Fixed session id sent as `x-opencode-session` for every request. **Leav"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"e unset unless you need the escape hatch**: the Zen free lane meters its quota per *session id*, so "},{"id":"p25s7","text":"a pinned id makes every conversation share one bucket (one 429 then breaks the whole app until the i"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"d changes). Unpinned, the adapter derives a canonical id per conversation from its first user turn —"},{"id":"p25s9","text":" stable across turns, distinct per conversation, so each conversation gets its own quota pool. Escap"},{"id":"p25s10","text":"e hatch for a conversation stuck on a sick upstream replica: pin a live OpenCode CLI session id here"},{"id":"p25s11","text":" and restart DSH. |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the
conversation's first us"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"er turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible),
and each request gets a fresh random id, mirrorin"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"g the CLI.
- **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev
pricing metadata"},{"id":"p28s4","text":" decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list.
A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream "},{"id":"p28s5","text":"outages.
- **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first
catalog fetch"},{"id":"p28s6","text":" races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin
retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before"},{"id":"p28s7","text":" settling into the periodic
refresh.
- **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local G"},{"id":"p28s8","text":"o agent (a
single-tenant port of opencode2api)
on `127.0.0.1:<random>`, token-authenticated, and reg"},{"id":"p28s9","text":"isters a standard
`llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from
`legacy/ag"},{"id":"p28s10","text":"ent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Gateway compatibility (Zen gate tracking)"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Zen's free lane gates third-party clients and moves models between APIs
without notice. Two mechanis"},{"id":"p30s2","text":" gates third-party clients and moves models between APIs
without notice. Two mechanisms matter here:"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- **Canonical sessions (upstream)** — the gateway only serves
`x-opencode-session` ids shaped `ses_<"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"12 hex><14 base62>`; every identity
is hashed into that shape, so plain DSH conversations pass with "},{"id":"p31s3","text":"no setup.
- **Responses-only models (this fork)** — `muse-spark-*` return a bare 500 on
`/chat/compl"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"etions` but 200 on `/responses`. The adapter routes them to
pi-ai `openai-responses` (wider 300 s bo"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"dy-idle watchdog for bursty
reasoning); everything else stays on `openai-completions`."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- No secrets involved: the anonymous lane's key is the literal string `public`; nothing is stored, n"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"othing telemetry.
- Install paths restricted to `lib/` only; no build scripts run from dependencies."},{"id":"p33s3","text":"
- All requests go directly from your machine to `opencode.ai` / `models.dev`."}],"truncated":true}
